paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the training and validation accuracy over the course of 30 epochs for a machine learning model. The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 30 on a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents accuracy as a percentage, ranging from 40% to 100%, also on a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 10. The blue line, labeled "Train," depicts the training accuracy, starting at approximately 45% at epoch 0, rising to near 100% by epoch 30, with notable fluctuations including a dip to around 55% at epoch 10 and a sharp rise to 80% at epoch 15. The green line, labeled "Validation," depicts the validation accuracy, starting at approximately 45% at epoch 0, rising to around 82% by epoch 30, with fluctuations including a dip to around 42% at epoch 10 and a peak near 75% at epoch 20. Both lines show an overall increasing trend, with the training accuracy consistently higher than the validation accuracy throughout the epochs shown.
